notes: Rates are USD per million tokens and mirror the Claude API first-party list price. Partner-operated platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud) publish their own rates and are not represented here.

cache_read_per_million_tokens is the cache-hit rate; cache_write_per_million_tokens is the short-lived (5m) cache-creation rate. Both are published per model. No catalog publishes a 1h cache-creation rate, so consumers derive it from the input rate.
Claude Sonnet 5 is priced at 2.00 input / 10.00 output. Anthropic made the launch price permanent and cancelled the previously announced increase to 3.00 / 15.00.
Claude Opus 5.5 cache reads cost 0.05x its input rate, unlike the usual 0.10x rate.
Models are omitted rather than guessed. An unpriced model is a supported state; a wrong price is not.
